title.zh: 【Kraken 母公司 Payward 已购买 AAVE，并与 Aave 正探讨未来合作的可能性】
title.en: 【Kraken 母公司 Payward 已购买 AAVE，并与 Aave 正探讨未来合作的可能性】

current_state.zh: Kraken parent Payward, through its Digital Asset Special Investments I fund and asset-management clients, has bought an undisclosed amount of AAVE on the secondary market and says it may buy more while exploring future collaboration with Aave, following an earlier proposal that reportedly involved 250,000 AAVE and 15% of Aave Group equity at a $385M valuation.
